title: Persistent failure of Euclidean quartic SOS exactness
summary: An explicit rational homogeneous cubic with 25 monomials in 14 real variables has maximum one on the Euclidean unit sphere and admits a positive degree-four moment functional with value 500753357629/500000000000. For every positive real regularization parameter, quadratic strength and cubic strength, the associated quartic has an explicitly attained global minimum whose shift is not a sum of squares of real polynomials.
